name: Windows Performance
description: The Sumo Logic application for Windows Performance provides insight into your system's operation and events so that you can better manage and maintain your Windows systems. The app uses predefined Dashboards and Searches that provide visibility into your environment for real time analysis of overall usage: CPU Performance, Disk Performance, Memory Performance, Network Performance, and Generic IO Performance.

children.name: Alert - Hosts with High CPU during Last 15 mins

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Windows/OS/Windows "Win32_PerfFormattedData_PerfOS_Processor" "_Total"
| parse regex "winbox = (?<dest_host>\S+)" nodrop 
| if (isNull(dest_host) or dest_host="",_sourceHost,dest_host) as host
| kv regex "= (?:\"|)(.*?)(?:\"|);" keys "PercentProcessorTime" as procTime
| timeslice 1m 
| avg(procTime) as AvgProcTime by host,_timeslice 
// High CPU Threshold: 80%
| where AvgProcTime>= 80
| count as DataPoints by host 
// Second threshold: The cpu is high for at least 10 minutes within the last 15mins
| where DataPoints >= 10

children.description: Schedule this alert to run for every 15 mins and for the last 15 minutes. Alert thresholds can be changed in the query.

children.name: Alert - Hosts with Low Available Memory in Last 15 Minutes

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Windows/OS/Windows "Win32_PerfFormattedData_PerfOS_Memory" "AvailableBytes"
| parse regex "winbox = (?<dest_host>\S+)" nodrop 
| if (isNull(dest_host) or dest_host="",_sourceHost,dest_host) as host
| kv regex "= (?:\"|)(.*?)(?:\"|);" keys "AvailableBytes" as aBytes
| timeslice 1m
| avg(aBytes) as AvgAvailableBytes by host,_timeslice 
| int(AvgAvailableBytes/(1024*1024)) as AvgAvailMBytes 
// 100MB is the threshold for this alert
| where AvgAvailMBytes < 100 
| count as DataPoints by host 
// another threshold: more than 10 minutes where the limit drops under the above threshold
| where DataPoints >10

panels.name: Total Bandwidth (Bytes) by Host
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Windows/OS/Windows "Win32_PerfFormattedData_Tcpip_NetworkInterface" 
| parse regex "winbox = (?<dest_host>\S+)" nodrop  
| if (isNull(dest_host) or dest_host="",_sourceHost,dest_host) as host
| kv regex "= (?:\"|)(.*?)(?:\"|);" keys "BytesReceivedPersec","BytesSentPersec","Name" as bytesReceived, bytesSent,interface
| sum(bytesReceived) as bytesReceived , sum(bytesSent) as bytesSent group by host
| (bytesSent + bytesReceived) as total_Bandwidth //| transpose row host column interface
| fields host,total_Bandwidth
